_comment: Pinned SG13CMOS5L PDK revision this sim/ tree's SG13CMOS5L-branch evidence records (sim/ldo-cmos5l-pvt-sweep/) were generated against -- the SG13CMOS5L counterpart of sim/pdk.json (SG13G2). Every record under sim/ldo-cmos5l-pvt-sweep/records/*.md must trace to this file (or a later commit that bumps it) -- see sim/README.md 'PDK pin'. Not consumed by tooling; kept as a plain, greppable fact sheet.
fetch_method: klayout-tools scripts/fetch-ihp-sg13cmos5l.sh (the master; this repo does not copy its download logic): downloads the codeload tarball of the pinned IHP-Open-PDK commit, verifies its sha256, extracts only the ihp-sg13cmos5l/ subtree next to an already-fetched ihp-sg13g2 sibling (scripts/fetch-ihp-sg13g2.sh, run first), and stamps <PDK_ROOT>/ihp-sg13cmos5l/.fetched-version. CI checks the script out of the immutable klayout-tools commit in .github/workflows/ci.yml KLAYOUT_TOOLS_REF (159527a551596caa74f290dcab08bdb8cc78ce93; klayout-tools#2720 migrated the script, v0.7.0 predates it).
release_tag: none -- IHP-Open-PDK dev branch commit, not a release tag; pinned by commit sha (see pinned_commit below)
pinned_commit_verified: 2026-10-12 -- constants read from the fetch script at klayout-tools 159527a551596caa74f290dcab08bdb8cc78ce93 (IHP_SG13CMOS5L_COMMIT, IHP_SG13CMOS5L_SHA256) and the script itself ran to completion (it exits non-zero on checksum mismatch) in a clean scratch PDK root; see local_install_verified.

superseded_pin._comment: HISTORICAL. Every record in sim/*/records/ and layout/ report committed before the issue #155 re-stamp was generated against this pin (or against the fleet's baked tree, see sim/README.md). Those records are append-only and stay labelled with it; sim/migration-inventory-155.md lists each selected citation and its new-pin disposition.

pdk_root_layout: PDK_ROOT/ihp-sg13cmos5l -- installed NEXT TO an ihp-sg13g2 install under the SAME PDK_ROOT (design/README.md 'Install shape is a dispatch hazard': this PDK's device symbols and HV model cards are relative symlinks into the sibling, e.g. libs.tech/ngspice/models/cornerMOShv.lib -> ../../../../ihp-sg13g2/libs.tech/ngspice/models/cornerMOShv.lib). The fetch script refuses to run without the sibling. With the sibling at IHP-Open-PDK v0.3.0 (sim/pdk.json) 262 of 530 symlinks in the new subtree dangle (moscap models, gnucap, xyce, LVS/pycell helpers that v0.3.0 does not ship); none of them is a file this design's netlist or simulations load -- the model libraries, Verilog-A sources and xschem symbols they use resolve (checked 2026-10-12, issue #155).

local_install_verified.path_marker: <PDK_ROOT>/ihp-sg13cmos5l/.fetched-version (written by the fetch script; the new install has no .git)
local_install_verified.value_read: f7bca32694fe3d58be0cc7d9df4b9f5db7161a14 (cat .fetched-version in a clean scratch install, 2026-10-12)

osdi_toolchain._comment: Same toolchain and pins as sim/pdk.json's osdi_toolchain block (sim/tools/build-osdi.sh is PDK-parameterized via ${PDK}/${PDK_ROOT}, not SG13G2-specific -- see sim/env.sh); restated here because this PDK's OSDI outputs live under a different PDK_ROOT/<PDK> path and additionally cover the two MoM-cap models SG13G2's own tree does not need (cap_cmomi/cap_cmomf -- the Miller compensation cap XCc in ldo_erramp_cmos5l.sch).
osdi_toolchain.approach: source-compile the PDK's own Verilog-A models with a checksum-pinned prebuilt OpenVAF-Reloaded (openvaf-r)
osdi_toolchain.install_dir: PDK_ROOT/ihp-sg13cmos5l/libs.tech/ngspice/osdi (PDK-install territory, not tracked in this repo)
osdi_toolchain.note: cap_cmomf.osdi and psp103_nqs.osdi/mosvar.osdi are loaded by every testbench in sim/ldo-cmos5l-pvt-sweep/ per the shared pre_osdi convention even though this design does not instantiate cap_cmomf or use the NQS/mosvar variants -- same posture sim/pdk.json's note takes for the SG13G2 tree.
osdi_toolchain.ngspice_actually_used: ngspice-46 (see sim/ldo-cmos5l-pvt-sweep/records/*.md for the exact `ngspice -v` string each record was generated with)
osdi_toolchain.ngspice_version_floor: 46 -- identical constraint to sim/pdk.json; see that file for the full rationale (OSDI ABI v0.4 vs. Ubuntu 24.04's apt ngspice 42).

pdk_caveats_honoured._comment: The SG13CMOS5L-specific analog caveats design/README.md 'PDK caveats honoured' already lists for the schematic; restated here because sim/ldo-cmos5l-pvt-sweep/ is the experiment that has to actually EVIDENCE them, per issue #21's acceptance criteria.
pdk_caveats_honoured.mom_cap_no_corner_or_mismatch_model: cornerCAP.lib (this pin): every cap_typ/cap_typ_mismatch/cap_typ_stat/cap_bcs/cap_wcs/cap_wcs_mismatch section maps to the SAME nominal cap_cmomi.lib/cap_cmomf.lib include -- verified directly by reading the file at this pin, not assumed. A PVT corner sweep over Cc's value is therefore a no-op by construction; sim/ldo-cmos5l-pvt-sweep/README.md 'MoM-cap (Cc) sensitivity sweep' runs a VALUE sensitivity sweep instead (Cc width scaled 0.5x/1x/2x nominal), the sweep design/README.md's own 'PDK caveats honoured' table says this issue owes.
pdk_caveats_honoured.cap_cmomi_not_validated_on_cmos5l_silico: cap_cmomi.lib's own header (read at this pin): coefficients are TRANSFERRED from the SG13G2 characterisation by layer count, none measured on cmos5l silicon; explicitly flagged 'APPROXIMATE MODEL -- NOT YET VALIDATED'. Every loop-gain/phase-margin result in this experiment that depends on Cc's value inherits this caveat and is marked insufficient-evidence in the spec table, per issue #21 acceptance criterion 4.
pdk_caveats_honoured.rhigh_family_width_offset_double_count: resistors_mod.lib's rhigh/rsil/rppd subckts each pre-narrow weff by the process spec's own DW* Line Width Delta before instancing their r3_cmc .model card, and that .model card's own xw parameter (r3_cmc.va: 'width offset (total)') applies the SAME delta again -- confirmed a PDK bug, not a convention, by issue #36 (DR-0006): every r3_cmc-based resistor flavour in the file shows the identical construction, and SG13G2_os_process_spec.pdf Rev 1.2 gives exactly one DW* target per device, matched by either application alone, never their sum. Affects both PDK branches identically -- ihp-sg13cmos5l/libs.tech/ngspice/models/resistors_mod.lib is a relative symlink into this same ihp-sg13g2 file. Every r3_cmc simulation this repo has ever run (including every record cited elsewhere in this file) already used the double-narrowed model, so no committed result moves; only the documented symbol-expression value (Rz: 1.700 MOhm, divider legs: 300.44 kOhm) differs from what was actually simulated (Rz: ~1.774 MOhm, divider legs: 313.5 kOhm). Filed upstream: https://github.com/IHP-GmbH/IHP-Open-PDK/issues/1235. See spec/decision-records/DR-0006-rhigh-family-width-offset-double-count.md.
